title: Rebuild the Linux test environment from the repository with one command, using the project's pinned tool versions (177, DRIVE-22)
description: Rebuild the Linux test environment from the repository with one command, using the project's pinned tool versions (177, DRIVE-22)
acceptance_criteria: DRIVE-22 (Leif, relayed by orc 2026-11-06, 'Capture as written'; chough#177), in the new REQ-cli-058. tools/linux/ holds the Dockerfile (three stages for chough-linux:1/:2/:3, with tool versions as build arguments), pins.sh (reads the specsync, fledge and human-intent pins from .github/workflows/ci.yml and refuses missing or disagreeing pins), image.sh, verify.sh and check-versions.sh. fledge run linux-image builds the images; fledge run linux-verify runs fledge lanes run verify on the current commit in chough-linux:3 and refuses with exit 3 when a tool is not pinned. The five new tests in tests/linux_image.rs need no Docker and fail first. The images are rebuilt with fledge run linux-image and linux-verify passes on Linux. Docs, AGENTS.md and CHANGELOG say so. linux-verify comes from ch-c456's linux-verify.sh at its request.

answers.constraints: DRIVE-22 (new); FLOW-17 (macOS and Linux); CI's pins in .github/workflows/ci.yml are the one source of tool versions; no crates.io publish by us (cargo install of published versions only); coordinated with ch-c456: REQ-cli-058, linux-verify owned here, its scratch script retired after this lands.
